measures.title: Local Sales Tax Option
measures.summary: Asks whether the City of Richmond may levy an additional general retail sales tax of up to 1%. The money could be used only for capital projects to build or majorly renovate schools in the city. If approved, the tax would expire no later than June 30, 2046.
measures.yesMeans: The City of Richmond is authorized to levy an additional sales tax of up to 1% for school construction and major renovation, expiring no later than June 30, 2046.
measures.noMeans: The City of Richmond is not authorized to levy this additional sales tax.
